method: Pageviews measure attention on Wikipedia, not demand or willingness to pay.
Interest is the topic articles' share of all human pageviews in that edition (views per million), so edition size and edition-wide trends cancel out.
Growth compares each month with the same month a year earlier, which cancels seasonality.
The 90% range comes from resampling those month pairs; with few pairs it can be slightly too narrow.
Only each article's current title is counted: views of redirects and former titles are not.
Human traffic as classified by Wikimedia; some automated traffic may remain.
